summary: BeOne Medicines Ltd. (formerly BeiGene) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose the conclusion of a statutory tax audit in China and a settlement with the local tax authority. The settlement resulted in agreed adjustments to previously filed tax returns, leading to an income tax payment (including surcharges and interest) of approximately RMB 446 million. No administrative penalty was involved. The payment will be recognized in the company's U.S. GAAP financial statements for Q2 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure regarding a tax settlement, not a special situation event.
